plugins.text: Marketplaces not explicitly approved are blocked by default. Add an approved marketplace under ~/.claude/plugins/config.json repositories.
Material Theme Free was pulled from VS Code marketplace in Feb 2024 due to malware variants. Use ms-vscode.theme-material-* alternatives.
ETHCode publisher compromise in 2024. Verify the current publisher identity before reinstalling.
Backdoored copy circulated on open-vsx in 2023. Use the marketplace-verified publisher only.
